descriptions.profiles.desktop: Tauri 2. Copied from the AntFabric desktop app's profile at the base (1280–2199px) breakpoint.
descriptions.profiles.mobile: Expo + gluestack (NativeWind). Copied from the AntFabric mobile app's theme tokens: 56pt call-to-action, 40pt icon buttons, 1.5 stroke, 1.4× leading.
descriptions.profiles.web: TanStack Start + Base UI. No AntFabric web app exists to copy from; these are the desktop values with a 24px minimum target (WCAG 2.2 AA 2.5.8) and one step more height on controls, because a browser is also used on touch laptops and at 90% zoom. Proposal — confirm with design.
